name: zovo-html-preview
displayName: HTML Preview & HTML Viewer (Live, CSS and Images, Offline)
description: Free HTML preview and HTML viewer beside your editor. Linked CSS, JS and images load, it updates as you type, and nothing is sent anywhere. No sign-in, no server, works offline.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode the preview does not run the page's JavaScript.

commands.title: Open HTML Preview to the Side

htmlPreview.followActiveEditor.description: When you switch to another HTML file, the open preview shows that file.

htmlPreview.updateDelayMs.description: How long to wait after you stop typing before the preview updates. Saved changes to linked CSS, JS and images show at once.

htmlPreview.runScripts.description: Run the page's JavaScript. It runs in a sandboxed frame that cannot reach VS Code, your files or the network. Turn it off to see the page as it looks without scripts.

htmlPreview.loadRemoteResources.description: Load CSS, fonts, scripts and images from the web (CDN links) in every page. When off, nothing is loaded from the web, and a bar offers "Load for this file".

enumDescriptions: Follow the VS Code theme, but only for pages that set no background of their own.
White, as a web browser shows it.
Dark, for pages that set no background of their own.
htmlPreview.pageBackground.description: Background and text color for pages that do not set their own. Pages with their own background always show it. You can change it from the toolbar.

htmlPreview.scrollSync.description: Scroll the preview with the editor. You can turn it on and off from the toolbar.

htmlPreview.maxFileMB.description: HTML files larger than this are not read until you click "Show anyway" in the preview. Files over 32 MB are never shown.

htmlPreview.maxResourceMB.description: Linked files (images, video, CSS, JS) larger than this are not put into the preview. The console panel names them.

htmlPreview.stuckScriptSeconds.description: If the page's scripts keep the preview busy for this long (an endless loop, for example), the preview stops them and shows the page without scripts.

htmlPreview.askForRating.description: Ask for a Marketplace rating after you have used HTML Preview on a few days. You can answer "Later" or "No thanks". Nothing is sent anywhere.

htmlPreview.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Sponsor and More free viewers links at the bottom of the preview. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with HTML Preview
walkthroughs.description: Preview HTML beside your code, with its CSS, scripts and images. No server, no account, no network.

steps.title: Open the preview
steps.description:
Open an .html file and click the preview icon in the editor title. Cmd+K V (Ctrl+K V) does the same. Your .html file stays a normal text editor.
[Find an .html file](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22.html%22%5D)

steps.title: Phone, tablet and desktop widths
steps.description: Pick a width (320 to 1440 px, or your own) and a zoom in the toolbar to check a responsive layout.

steps.title: Web resources and the console
steps.description:
Nothing loads from the web until you click "Load for this file". The console panel shows console.log output and script errors.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22htmlPreview%22%5D)
